description: Sri Lanka Institute of Architects - Amendment, Extra Ordinary Gaz. No. 2026/22 of 0rd  July, 2017 the notification relating to Regulations of the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects
reasoning: This gazette content involves the correction and revision of regulations for the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects, specifically repealing and replacing specific clauses in their membership regulations. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with amendments to statutory regulations and legal frameworks governing a professional institute, rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
